scope: Directus actor attribution versus staff foreign-key references

checks.summary: Directus extension build and TypeScript no-emit check

findings.staff_identity_crosswalk: No explicit operator-to-staff mapping was found in the inspected schema and service definitions.
findings.existing_operator_party_binding: operator_governance_party_binding links an authenticated operator to a canonical network party; it does not identify a staff row.
findings.metric_proposal: reviewed_by references staff.id. The hook no longer copies accountability.user into this field; explicitly supplied staff references remain subject to location validation.
findings.feedback_review: reviewer_id references staff.id. Automatic status-review records leave it null and preserve the authenticated Directus user UUID in private metadata.actor_directus_user_id.

limitations: This is source and mocked-hook verification, not live Directus or database acceptance.
The repository still lacks a reviewed mapping proving that an authenticated operator is a particular staff member.
Feedback-review read/update/delete parity, broader Directus field/relation/hook parity, and runtime parity remain open.
No migration, candidate database, legacy database, provider, or live service was used.
rollback: Keep these attribution safeguards. Reintroduce staff attribution only after an explicit, reviewed operator-to-staff mapping and corresponding scoped tests exist.
